newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market slipps in dormant trading.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market slipps in dormant trading.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market went down on Tuesday in lacklustre trading, with investors waiting for further falls before investing in blue chips, traders said.
"Big players are showing no interest in buying yet," one trader said. "They expect prices to dive further, mainly in heavyweights."
Operators forecast thin interest and a negative mood for the remainder of the week. They said some interest might emerge for small cap stocks but this would not be able to move the market upward.
Three independent indices, computed by brokerage houses, based on average prices and market capitalisation, went down from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index slid by 1.7 percent to 5,942.4 points, BIG-OTC lost 3.55 percent to 4,193.44 points and CAS-RQ fell 3.7 percent to 899 points.
Rubber manufacturer Rolast was one of the most traded stocks on Tuesday, closing 150 lei firmer at 2,850 under buying pressure.
Oil refineries and cement makers lost ground again amid selling pressure from local investors.
Petromidia refinery ended 2,000 lei weaker at 33,000, while Petrobrazi, another refinery, closed 5,000 lei down at 30,500.
Cement maker Romcim, one of the OTC market stars, edged down 3,000 lei to 91,000.
Turnover fell on Tuesday to 16.41 billion lei from 19.45 billion on Monday.
